responses.generate: Engineered zinc finger nucleases combine modular DNA recognition with dedicated nuclease domains for precise genome editing {{R1}}. Early studies established how C2H2 motifs read target sequences with high specificity {{R2}}. Subsequent engineering fused these modules to cleavage domains, enabling targeted double-strand breaks {{R1}}. These modular platforms now support therapeutic development and functional genomics studies {{R2}}.
